about_the_game:
SYNOPSIS

You are a debtor burdened with massive debt.
Just when all hope seemed lost, a company reached out with an offer.

Mission : “Laboratory Exploration and Report”
Inside the laboratory, monsters born from biological experiments—mutations—roam freely.

You must work with your team to eliminate the ‘Primary Mutation’.
But there are other mutations in the lab that will interfere with you.

The reward is divided among surviving team members.
The fewer survivors, the bigger your share.

If you succeed in the mission, you can earn a large reward and repay your debt, but the interest keeps accumulating.
If you're too late to repay… you will be terminated.

Can you repay your debt?
Or… will you just end up being recycled as well?

KEY FEATURES

  • A first-person horror survival game where up to 4 players can cooperate or betray each other

  • Ever-changing combinations of main and secondary mutations

  • Intelligent mutations that react to movement, footsteps, and voice

  • Experience relentless tension tightening in a dark laboratory

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10+ x64
  • Processor: Intel/AMD X64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: YES
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended for faster loading time. Turn off room lights and Put your headset on for best experience.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10+ x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4770K or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 2080 or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: YES
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended for faster loading time. Turn off room lights and Put your headset on for best experience.

short_description: Work together with your team in a lab filled with deadly mutations. Eliminate the Primary Mutation and claim your reward. Only those who survive can pay off their debt.
